grammarFocus: 复合句与简单句搭配；条件、让步和原因表达；标点。
title: Economic Choices and Public Priorities
prompt: In many countries, governments must decide how to allocate limited public funds among competing priorities such as healthcare, education, transport and environmental protection. Some people argue that economic growth should always come first, because a stronger economy makes all other goals easier to achieve. Others believe that spending should prioritise immediate social needs, even if this slows economic growth. To what extent do you agree or disagree with the view that economic growth should always be the first priority for governments? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟雅思学术类写作 Task 2 练习，所有情境与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先明确你对“政府应始终把经济增长置于首位”这一观点的立场（完全同意、部分同意或不同意），并在引言中清楚表述。主体段落应围绕你的立场展开完整议论文：每个主体段提出一个中心论点，并用解释、因果分析和具体例子加以支持；同时回应反方观点，说明为何你的立场更有说服力。结论需重申立场并概括主要理由，不要引入新论点。注意任务回应、连贯衔接、词汇资源与语法多样性的平衡，全文不少于 250 词。
